status: UNSELECTED rail-monitor study; not a complete permit/protection circuit

supervisor.input_current_table_condition: VSENSEx=5.5 V; treating this as an absolute envelope at the 0.8 V sense node is a proposed condition, not a newly sourced guarantee.
supervisor.pairing: RESET2 combines SENSE3 and SENSE4. Unused SENSE1/2 and RESET1 follow the datasheet no-connect instruction; no third independent reset is invented.

resistor_condition.reference_temperature_scope: 25 C is an analysis reference assumption; the retained exact product sheets do not state the nominal-resistance reference temperature. Applicability remains OPEN.

divider_candidates.meaning: Magnitude divider in a proposed floating domain referenced to VN. Both paired sense pins share the divider. Domain survival is not established.

floating_negative_trial.counterexample_scope: Forced bounded voltages for architectural screening, not a claim that the existing assembled circuit reaches them. Missing negative sink plus other powered paths is not proved to keep VN nonpositive.
floating_negative_trial.source_scope: Default-low F ordering option is conditional on receiving-side power and no parasitic power through IN; intermediate supplies and unpowered receiver are undefined.

comparison.decision: Do not use nominal timing as a guaranteed fault-response maximum.

open_obligations: Actual 0.8 V input-bias envelope, nominal-resistance reference temperature, resistor thermal/installation and complete threshold applicability.
A negative-rail front end that remains within all pin ratings when the negative rail is absent or rises above AGND.
Surviving control power, defined startup/brownout output states, and real all-rail AND/latch/permit driver.
Fault slew/overdrive, actual pullup/load and switching path must match a maximum-delay guarantee; nominal startup time is not a bound.
Independent inlet-return and local-device-GND integrity cannot be inferred from rail voltages.
Complete part/decoupler/current/area allocation and all 82 output, 16 sense and 30 reference isolation paths.
No native CAD, dynamic model, installed thermal or bench qualification performed for this monitor study.
